title: Lipschitz extension into R^l with exact sup bound (fact Ext plus radial retraction)
statement: Let A be a subset of R^n, g : R^n -> R^l, M >= 0 and R_0 >= 0 with |g(x) - g(z)| <= M |x - z| for x, z in A and |g(x)| <= R_0 for x in A. Then there is f : R^n -> R^l with f = g on A, |f(x) - f(z)| <= sqrt(l) M |x - z| for all x, z, and |f(x)| <= R_0 for all x.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (A : Set (Rn n)) (g : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (M R₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ M → 0 ≤ R₀ → (∀ x ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, ‖g x - g z‖ ≤ M * ‖x - z‖) → (∀ x ∈ A, ‖g x‖ ≤ R₀) → ∃ f : Rn n → Rn ℓ, (∀ x ∈ A, f x = g x) ∧ (∀ x z, ‖f x - f z‖ ≤ Real.sqrt ℓ * M * ‖x - z‖) ∧ ∀ x, ‖f x‖ ≤ R₀
